newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sweden finmin does not see much more ERM pressure.
newsitem.headline: Sweden finmin does not see much more ERM pressure.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said on Sunday he did not believe Italy's ERM entry would sharply increase pressure on Sweden to join the currency grid.
After Italy's move, the ERM groups 12 of the EU's 15 currencies. Only Sweden, Greece and Britain remain outside.

Many countries believe ERM membership is a requirement for joining economic and monetary union. But asked whether the decision would increase pressure on Sweden to join, Asbrink told reporters in Brussels: "I don't think it will to any greater extent."
He made clear it would not change Sweden's attitude towards the issue. Stockholm has repeatedly said the issue is not on the agenda now even if it has not ruled out entry sometime in the future
Swedish Central Bank Governor Urban Backstrom said the meeting of EU finance ministers and central bank governors had not discussed the crown.
"No, not at all. We have only talked about Italy," he told reporters. Backstrom also said Italy's decision had not changed the Swedish attitude on the issue. -- Brussels newsroom +32 2 287 68 11
